metadata.query: What kind of bomb killed the most people during World War 2?

reasoning_steps.thought: I need to find out which bomb killed the most people during World War 2.
reasoning_steps.action_input: "What bomb killed the most people during World War 2?"

final_answer: The bomb that killed the most people during World War 2 was the atomic bomb dropped on Nagasaki, Japan, on August 9, 1945. The bombing resulted in the deaths of an estimated 70,000 people instantly, and many more later due to radiation exposure and other factors. Source: "Nagasaki Atomic Bombing" by Wikipedia, available at <https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nagasaki_atomic_bombing>.
